Check for mismatch of object type

Source: R/checks-assert.R
check_object_type.Rd

Function to check mismatch between actual object class and anticipated type

Usage

check_object_type(
  x,
  type,
  arg = rlang::caller_arg(x),
  call = rlang::caller_env()
)

Arguments

x

Input value

type

Object type

arg

See caller_arg

call

See caller_env

Value

An error message if the input object and type does not match. Otherwise, an invisible TRUE.

Details

This function is used to check the object type of an input value based on base R package. In base R package, object type functions are specified in is.ObjectType format.

For instance, base::is.logical is used for checking a logical/Boolean value. Please see examples below how base functions are translated in this function.

See also

Other checks function: check_colnames(), check_duplicate_records(), check_list_names(), check_non_missing_value(), check_value_match(), check_vector_length(), detect_decimal_value(), detect_numeric_value(), is_datadict_tbl()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Without error message
check_object_type(x = letters[1:12], type = "character")
check_object_type(x = ADNIMERGE2::CDR, type = "data.frame")
check_object_type(x = TRUE, type = "logical")

# With error message
check_object_type(x = letters[1:12], type = "numeric")
check_object_type(x = letters[1:12], type = "factor")
} # }
